notes.title: Ezrebeth, our new full-length visual novel, is out now!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3175950/Ezrebeth][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188600/59dbc37ccb8dd49ae522bacc8e04001b33b361d5.png[/img][/url]

[b]Rise and shine, Dwellers![/b]

[b]Ezrebeth[/b] is finally [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3175950/Ezrebeth]here[/url]!

Experience the most surreal [b]Tymedust Games[/b] story yet, offering a time-bending narrative of truly memorable proportions...

[i]“Many twists and turns, with a lot of depth to the characters.”[/i]
- [b]Hidden Gem Discovery[/b]

[i]“An intriguing and unusual story, gripping with its superb writing and distinctive artwork. Highly recommended.”[/i]
- [b]Critiques Sans Frontiers[/b]

[i]“An overall display of tragedy, the clash of humane and inhumane, love and inability to love, mundane and the divine, and the great incompatibility of the two options.”[/i]
- [b]User Review[/b]

We've also put together two bundles at reduced price points if you're looking to complete your collection of games and soundtracks from us: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51431/Pitstop_in_Purgatory__Ezrebeth_Duo_Pack]Pitstop in Purgatory + Ezrebeth Duo Pack[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51432/Purgatoryverse_Complete_Pack]Purgatoryverse Complete Pack[/url].

Thank you so much everyone for your support, and we hope you'll enjoy this brand new story of ours!

[i][b]All the love,
Tymedust Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Poetry in Purgatory DEMO available NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Rise and shine, Dwellers![/h1]

We're beyond excited to share that the [b]demo[/b] for [b]Poetry in Purgatory[/b] is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704840/Poetry_in_Purgatory/#game_area_purchase]now available[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780352/f6d8b513fa733f2a3ac8dfb594be540cc8934cbd.png[/img]
Weighing in at almost [i]100 000 words[/i], the demo is quite large and very replayable, offering branching morality choices, two love interests, three optional side stories and much more. You'll be able to get a pretty clear picture of what the full game will bring, along with brand new features such as the [b]PurgaPhone[/b] (send and receive messages to/from your friends and foes in Purgatory) and the [b]quest log[/b] (no more wondering where to go next).

[i]In addition, the full game will allow you to restore your progress, should you not want to replay everything from the beginning![/i]

We want to make this game as special as it can possibly be, so we'd love to hear your thoughts and impressions over in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2704840/discussions/]community hub[/url] if you decide to try out the demo. :)

[b]And as always, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704840/Poetry_in_Purgatory/#game_area_purchase]wishlisting[/url] the game helps us out a [i]ton[/i]![/b]

Have yet to take the plunge into the world of [b]Purgatory[/b], or perhaps you're itching to bring a friend into the afterlife at a reduced cost? [i]We've got you covered[/i]! 

[b]Pitstop in Purgatory[/b] is currently [i]30% off[/i] as part of [b]Steam's 2024 Summer Sale[/b]! Don't miss the chance to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2077080/Pitstop_in_Purgatory/]go buy it[/url] if you haven't already.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780352/2d123c1c25bd884a623ce8e83ca5d3cdcdf8ca34.png[/img]
Looking for a short, surreal experience set face-to-face with the one and only [b]The Guide[/b]? [i]We know some of you certainly do.[/i] Then perhaps you'll enjoy [b]Guidelicious[/b], an absolutely [b]free[/b] micro game set in the world of [b]Purgatory[/b]. Play it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2544550/Guidelicious/]right here[/url], and be sure to collect all the achievements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780352/df6651fc33ea6d6e482afe513b9a6f8709be84c6.png[/img]

[i]Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for all your support, it truly means the world to us!

[b]Tymedust[/b][/i]
